title: calceolaria corymbosa subsp. mimuloides
intro: Calceolaria corymbosa subsp. mimuloides, commonly known as "Pocketbook", is a plant species belonging to the Calceolaria genus. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calceolaria corymbosa subsp. mimuloides include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which may contribute to its use in treating coughs, colds, and bronchitis. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
